overall_assessment: Reviewed all 28 fetched plans and three failed-fetch entries: substantive plan sections and facts boxes are preserved, academic-year headings match the requested years, and DAT300's sole short flag reflects the source page referring readers to UiB rather than extraction loss. The three soft-404 URLs follow the established course/academic-year pattern and do not establish a URL defect; omitted year stamps, staff details, exam schedules and reading-list widget labels are consistent with the content specification, and no missing bibliography is demonstrated. The only clear extraction defect is a generic exam-help link label retained in 23 of 28 fetched plans.

findings.description: 23 of 28 fetched plans retain a standalone generic link label after the permitted examination aids: 'Mer om hjelpemidler', 'Meir om hjelpemiddel', or the quoted English equivalent. These website link labels are boilerplate rather than course-specific assessment rules and violate the requirement to include only the plan. The surrounding aid rules remain readable; this is minor recurring noise that the pre-pass junk patterns did not flag.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The HVL configuration in R/institution_config.R selects div.l-body and excludes sidebar buttons, year links and coordinator/exam widgets, but does not exclude the generic examination-aids link inside the main plan. R/blocks.R therefore retains its anchor text in extracted_text.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an HVL exclude XPath in R/institution_config.R that removes only anchor elements whose normalize-space(.) equals 'Mer om hjelpemidler', 'Meir om hjelpemiddel', or 'More about examination support material'. Preserve the adjacent course-specific permitted-aids text and subsequent credit-overlap rows, then rebuild extracted_text from the stored harvest.
